title: Practice 5: One direction, or round and about

blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: Я ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.) на твой сайт.
exercises.why: **ходила** — past tense (feminine) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).

exercises.q: По городу ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.) молва.
exercises.why: **ходила** — past tense (feminine) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: A rumor circulated through the city.

exercises.q: Она не ___ (ходить — to go, walk, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.) в спортзал.
exercises.why: **ходила** — past tense (feminine) of ходить: many-directions verb (one direction: идти).
exercises.prompt: She did not walk to the gym.

exercises.q: Ты когда-нибудь ___ (летать — to fly, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.) на аэростате?
exercises.why: **летала** — past tense (feminine) of летать: many-directions verb (one direction: лететь).
exercises.prompt: Have you ever flown in a blimp?

exercises.q: Вы ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., past pl.) на Хоккайдо?
exercises.why: **ездили** — past tense (plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Летом я ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., past f. sg.) на Бали.
exercises.why: **ездила** — past tense (feminine) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).
exercises.prompt: I went to Bali in the summer.

exercises.q: Они не ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., past pl.) в Уганду.
exercises.why: **ездили** — past tense (plural) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Он ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) в командировку.
exercises.why: **ездил** — past tense (masculine) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Я ___ (ездить — to go by vehicle, ride, there and back or in general; impf., past m. sg.) вчера в Диснейленд.
exercises.why: **ездил** — past tense (masculine) of ездить: many-directions verb (one direction: ехать).

exercises.q: Несмотря на то, что на улице ___ (идти — to go, walk, one way; impf., past m. sg.) дождь, я выгулял свою собаку.
exercises.why: **шел** — past tense (masculine) of идти: one-direction verb (many directions: ходить).
exercises.prompt: I took the dog for a walk even though it was raining.
